title: What Remediation Copilot does in a UVM ticket, what it will not do, and its limits

what-it-is.statement: Remediation Copilot is an AI-powered assistant integrated into UVM tickets, accessed from the ticket drawer; previously saved chats appear in the ticket's Fixes tab.

quotes: Remediation Copilot is an AI-powered assistant integrated into Zscaler Unified Vulnerability Management (UVM) tickets.
Remediation Copilot is accessed from the ticket drawer. Previously saved chats appear in the ticket's Fixes tab.

guidance-only.statement: Remediation Copilot only provides guidance and does not apply changes; users must review and test the instructions before implementing them.

quotes: Remediation Copilot only provides guidance; it does not apply changes. You must review and test instructions in your environment before implementing them.

privacy-optin.statement: The What Is Remediation Copilot page says data shared with Remediation Copilot is not transmitted to external third parties and the system strips PII where possible, but that some ticket fields might contain sensitive information so users should review content before submitting it; it also says use of AI features in the SecOps platform is optional, controlled by admin opt-in.

quotes: Remediation Copilot operates within Zscaler services, and data shared with it is not transmitted to external third parties.
Some ticket fields might contain sensitive information, so users should review content before submitting it.
Where possible, the system strips personally identifiable information (PII) before processing.
Use of AI-powered features in the Zscaler Security Operations (SecOps) platform is optional.
Availability is controlled via admin opt-in in your account.

admin-disable.statement: Account admins can remove access to Remediation Copilot by turning off AI capabilities in Account Settings.

quotes: Account admins can remove access to Remediation Copilot by turning off AI capabilities in Account Settings.

save-to-fixes.statement: Save to Fixes saves a summarized remediation plan to the ticket's Fixes tab under the AI tab for Fix Type, and multiple summaries can be saved to one ticket.

quotes: Click Save to Fixes to save a summarized version of the remediation plan to the ticket's Fixes tab.
The summary is saved to the ticket's Fixes tab under the AI tab for Fix Type.
Multiple summaries can be saved to a single ticket, allowing you to capture any updates or alternative approaches.

limited-context.statement: When a ticket includes many findings, Remediation Copilot might run in limited-context mode and not take all findings into account; the documented workaround is to split the findings of interest into a new ticket and run it there.

quotes: When a ticket includes many findings, Remediation Copilot might run in limited-context mode and not take all findings in the ticket into account.
If you need full-context recommendations for a specific subset of findings, split those findings into a new ticket and run Remediation Copilot there to generate detailed fix paths.

session-timeout.statement: If the session times out during long-running responses, Retry proceeds.

quotes: If the session times out during long-running responses, click Retry to proceed.

cve-guidance.statement: For CVEs, Remediation Copilot can help identify patch or upgrade options or suggest mitigations if fixes are unavailable, highlight operational considerations such as reboots for OS-level fixes, and distinguish direct from transitive dependencies.

quotes: Remediation Copilot can help you identify patch or upgrade options to address vulnerabilities, or suggest mitigation measures if fixes are unavailable.
It can also highlight operational considerations (e.g., reboots for OS-level fixes) and distinguish direct vs. transitive dependencies.

misconfig-guidance.statement: For misconfigurations, Remediation Copilot can recommend secure settings and compensating measures when a secure setup is not immediately feasible, and relate findings to compliance standards such as SOC 2 and PCI DSS.

quotes: Remediation Copilot can provide recommendations on secure settings, guidance for applying configuration changes, and compensating measures if a secure setup isn't feasible immediately.
Additionally, it can relate findings to relevant compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, PCI DSS).

code-guidance.statement: For code-level issues, Remediation Copilot can share best practices for secure coding or runtime mitigations and suggest compensating controls for flaws such as SQL injection or XSS when immediate remediation is not viable.

quotes: Remediation Copilot can share best practices for secure coding or runtime mitigations, and suggest compensating controls for flaws like SQL injection or XSS when immediate remediation isn't viable.

limited-context-threshold.title: How many findings in a ticket put Remediation Copilot into limited-context mode
limited-context-threshold.detail: The captured articles say a ticket with many findings might run in limited-context mode but give no finding count.

chat-handling.title: Which model Remediation Copilot uses, and how chats are retained and audited
chat-handling.detail: The captured Remediation Copilot articles do not state the model, chat retention or audit of chats.
